title: Karam
shortLine: An elite gathering wakes inside a prison where every test has a price.
synopsis: Ashish and Pankaj were once inseparable friends at IIT Kharagpur. Years later, one has risen into political power while the other has been left behind. At a lavish gathering of the powerful, the lights go out—and the guests awaken inside a tower where a mysterious captor forces them to confront the corruption they have lived beside.
imageAlt: A severe glass-and-concrete tower viewed from below
detailLine: The final test remembers what everyone else forgot.
underneath: The tower becomes a brutal theatre in which power loses its familiar protections. Yet revenge carries its own question: can a person expose a corrupt world without becoming shaped by the same cruelty?
visualMotifs: A bandaged figure in a doorway
A tower seen from far below
coreQuestion: When justice is unavailable, how easily can revenge begin to resemble the system it claims to punish?

detailImage.alt: A long, dark prison corridor with multiple levels
detailImage.caption: Inside the tower, every floor makes its own law.

readerImages.alt: A dense urban skyline where towers crowd the horizon
readerImages.caption: The city above keeps functioning while the tower closes around its guests.

readerImages.alt: A steel wristwatch with a dark dial seen in close-up
readerImages.caption: A watch is only an object until it carries the weight of a friendship.
